openQuestions.q: Should execution-boundary.allowedPaths be narrowed to docs/requirements/decisions and experiments/multi-model-ablation before PLAN approval, removing packages/main/src and packages/main/test from the implementation boundary?
openQuestions.evidence: The story is M0-only and the plan/checklist create only the canonical protocol doc plus experiments/multi-model-ablation examples/README, while execution-boundary.json currently allows packages/main/src and packages/main/test even though product gate/playbook/runtime/DONE policy changes are excluded.
openQuestions.resolution: Resolved as a PLAN-phase scope interpretation rather than an INIT boundary rewrite: execution_boundary_set is only available in INIT, so the recorded INIT execution boundary cannot be changed in PLAN. The authoritative implementation scope for this story remains the checklist files, scope-boundary exclusions, and plan.md: only docs/requirements/decisions and experiments/multi-model-ablation may be changed. packages/main/src and packages/main/test are not used by any checklist item and remain out of implementation scope despite the stale broad INIT execution-boundary artifact.
